hero.title: Inhale. Exhale. Practice.
hero.subtitle: Dharana is a companion for your daily yoga practice: an asana catalog with instructions, ready-made sequences, a practice timer and a personal sequence generator.

items.title: Asana catalog
items.text: Dozens of asanas with photos, descriptions, breathing technique and contraindications.

items.title: Ready sequences
items.text: Morning, evening, back and balance sequences — pick one and practice.

items.title: Practice timer
items.text: A built-in timer will guide you from warm-up to savasana.

items.title: Generator
items.text: Build your own sequence for your goals in seconds.

channels.title: Practice your way
channels.botText: Quick asana cards, guided practice with a timer and subscription — right in your favourite messenger.
channels.appText: Full practice, sequences and a generator for Android.
channels.appHint: Direct APK download — a temporary option until the Google Play release.

contacts.title: Contacts
contacts.text: Message us on Telegram — we'll help you find the right practice and answer your questions.
